sample_unit: AI-generated chart summaries with physician free-text feedback (10 physicians)

links.outcome: Physician-reported omissions, hallucinations, and confusing content in AI chart summaries
links.effect: Among 147 summaries: omissions n=46, confusing content n=20, token limitations n=27, hallucinations n=5, bias n=1; positive feedback n=71.
links.quote: Positive feedback was common (n = 71), but users identified omissions (n = 46), confusing content (n = 20), token limitations (n = 27), hallucinations (n = 5), and bias (n = 1).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of an EHR-integrated LLM chart summarization tool based on qualitative physician feedback during clinical workflow use, without testing a specific safeguard or deployment practice comparative arm.
